verdict.rationale: An AI app-building platform like Bolt.new could plausibly publish an interactive API reference, so this axis applies. The pack has no evidence of one: the OpenAPI/Swagger probe returned 404 on every candidate path, and the llms.txt support index is a docs listing, not a runnable API reference. Code view and the ability to call third-party APIs inside user apps are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
